items.scenario: You are not sure whether this bill has been paid or not and you need to check with your accounts person. The supplier is asking. You have only recently started buying from them.
items.reply: ek baar accounts se check karke batata hu, mujhe status pata nahi hai

items.scenario: Your company pays all suppliers in one batch on the 10th of each month. This bill missed the last batch. The supplier has messaged asking where the payment is.
items.reply: 10th wale payment run me ye miss ho gaya tha, next batch me jayega

items.scenario: You have been told by your manager not to release this payment but you have not been told why. The supplier is asking. You have only recently started buying from them.
items.reply: manager ne abhi payment release karne se mana kiya hai. reason check karke bataunga

items.scenario: You are waiting for your GST filing to be done before releasing payments this month. The supplier has followed up for the second time. You have only recently started buying from them.
items.reply: GST filing pending hai abhi, uske baad payments release karenge

items.scenario: The rate on the bill is higher than what was agreed in the purchase order. The supplier is chasing payment.
items.reply: bill ka rate PO wale rate se zyada hai, please check once

items.scenario: You will have money after a large customer of yours pays you, which you expect sometime near the end of the month. The supplier is asking for an update. You have a long-standing relationship with this supplier.
items.reply: month end ke aas paas customer ka payment expected hai, uske baad aapka clear kar denge

items.scenario: Your own customers owe you a lot of money and have not paid, so you cannot pay your suppliers either. The supplier is following up. This is the first time they have contacted you about it.
items.reply: customers se payments nahi aaye abhi tak, isliye supplier payments bhi delay ho gaye hain

items.scenario: Your company requires all supplier bills to be uploaded to a vendor portal. This one is not showing up there. The supplier says they sent it by email.
items.reply: email pe invoice mil gaya but portal pe nahi aa raha. waha upload karna padega
